name: issue-loop
description: Run an unattended build loop: one orchestrator session drives one implementer session through a repo's GitHub issues, one merged and deployed PR per task, with a gate between tasks.

interface.shortDescription: An orchestrator session drives an implementer through the issue queue
interface.longDescription: Teaches a Claude Code session to run an unattended build loop as orchestrator: it sends one task at a time to an implementer session (clear, full brief), waits for an exact DONE line with a clock, checks the result from outside with a gate script, keeps a ledger, reports in a few lines and sends the next task. Ships the brief template with the reason behind each rule, script templates with a swappable session driver (herdr bundled), a handoff template, and the honest limits of such a loop. Built for Claude Code sessions; not registered in the Codex marketplace.
defaultPrompt: Run the issue loop on this repo
Hand the loop over to a fresh orchestrator
